scope: Functional append-only audit contract and attributed business changes
Atomic persistence of domain result, AuditChange and Outbox evidence
Accounting period admission, closing, blocking and governed reopening
Segregation of duties and dual-control evidence anchored to real actors
Read-only audit query, retention handoff and adoption across bounded contexts

retrieval.provenance: Audit and Integrity expert derived from accepted UBP ADR-0009, Graphify evidence and official SAP and Dynamics documentation reviewed on 2026-09-10.

ubp.purpose: Accepted audit trail, period control and SoD authority with explicit partial implementation status
Published routing and governance context for audit and integrity
Curated comparison pressure without claiming UBP implementation

market.purpose: Queryable protected audit trail and retention boundary
Auditable records for configured sensitive table and field changes
SoD rules, risks, severity, mitigation and conformance validation

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: An immutable business fact naming actor, tenant, scope, operation, result, reason, before and after state, correlation and time.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Enterprise suites retain auditable change records for sensitive operations.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Telemetry or database logs alone never satisfy a functional audit requirement.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: The domain result, AuditChange and Outbox evidence succeed or fail in one transaction.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Audit evidence must not lag behind the business fact it is expected to prove.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: A confirmed financial mutation without durable audit evidence is blocked.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Posting admission enforced by legal entity, period state and posting permit inside the Ledger transaction.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP financial controls prevent posting into closed periods through accounting-domain configuration.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: UI or BFF checks are insufficient; every posting path must consume domain enforcement.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: A posted journal is corrected by a balanced reversal whose requesting actor and reason are audited.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Audit trails must explain corrections to posted financial records.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Updating or deleting a posted journal is absolutely prohibited.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Conflicting actions are prevented or mitigated based on distinct real actors and auditable policy.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Dynamics models conflicts between duties and requires validation of role assignments.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Creating a SoD rule is incomplete until existing and future assignments pass conformance.

mandatory recommendation package for valid escalations

mandatory governed workflow for inbound documents, approvals, payment authorization and accounting handoff
mandatory segmented chart of accounts and typed posting dimensions policy
mandatory country-agnostic engines, Control Plane configuration boundary and transversal accounting integrity

northStar.bestVersion: A cross-domain integrity spine where every sensitive business mutation is attributable, append-only, tenant-scoped and transactionally consistent, while period controls and SoD prevent unauthorized financial outcomes.
businessOutcomes: Explain who caused every sensitive financial change and why.
Prevent posting through closed periods from UI, API, event or job paths.
Detect and block conflicting duties before they produce fraud or error.
invariants: Posted journals are corrected only by attributed balanced reversal.
Audit history has no destructive application operation.
Period admission is enforced inside the posting transaction.
SoD evidence refers to distinct real actors, not merely different roles.
Append-only application behavior does not claim physical WORM without platform evidence.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Auditable event policy, period authority, SoD conflicts, retention and export are versioned policy; bounded contexts implement universal capture and enforcement primitives.

lessons.observedCapability: Protected, queryable audit trail with explicit retention management.
lessons.lesson: Capture, query authorization and retention are separate responsibilities.
lessons.ubpDecision: Keep domain capture local and atomic, expose read-only query, and require platform evidence for retention or WORM claims.

lessons.observedCapability: Configured logging of sensitive insert, update, delete and key rename operations.
lessons.lesson: Audit coverage must be explicit and performance-aware.
lessons.ubpDecision: Govern an auditable-event catalog and never claim universal coverage from a single Ledger pilot.

lessons.observedCapability: Conflict rules include duties, severity, risk and mitigation, followed by compliance validation.
lessons.lesson: Declaring a conflict rule does not clean existing role assignments.
lessons.ubpDecision: Run SoD conformance on policy and role changes and anchor conflicts to real actors.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract and deterministic broker behavior.
Require active ownership, approvals, pinned revision, manifest digest and verified seeds.
Block country leakage, hardcoded accounting decisions and non-durable posting failures.

enforcement.readyWhen: The manifest is valid, its registry authority is active, seeds resolve against the pinned UBP revision, applicable policies pass and implementation claims include reproducible code evidence.
